title: 0x26 Chain application, workload, and telemetry contracts
source_scope: The 27 April revision is a post-hoc source proxy. It already has fixed-count draining and the default-on insertion flag. It follows runs 180-182 and the partial-flush revert. It does not establish the exact source or binary identity for each measured run from 118 through 219. The development log supplies measurements; selected upstream changes supply the partial-flush mechanism and revert.

workload.structural_eligibility: Effectively 100% by construction in steady-state eligible bodies of one-sided equal-price orders. Empty/singleton bodies, rejections, and additional runtime items are separate.

reasons: Sharded helpers count market groups; contiguous helpers count local resting batches.
Early whole-body unsupported returns are not all included in attempts.
The direct path records helper statistics only after successful metadata installation.
The general executor also records statistics into the same counters.
counter_semantics.live_read_attempt: Three configured validator endpoints did not yield metrics. No service was started or changed.

application_error.april: Earlier canonical policy commits are not undone when a later commit fails. Nonce-only body filtering on retry can omit an already-advanced prefix. A persistent rejection can prevent progress.
application_error.may: The payload filter simulates candidates first. This reduces exposure, but the durable wrapper does not inspect the inner application Result.
durable_control_flow: Run f(C), obtaining T, which can be Err(NodeError) after a mutation.
Build and commit the plan for C.
Install C into the canonical engine.
application_error.storage_error: A metadata, plan, or backend error returns before clone installation. This is separate from the inner application error.
application_error.reachability_scope: Source-based conditional analysis. No injected failure or live wedge was reproduced. No claim that every late application error is reachable after the May prefilter.

duplicate_key.april: A duplicate reaching the resting-batch check fails the execution call. The general commit loop also propagates its error, but changes occur on overlays.
duplicate_key.may: The simulated payload filter ordinarily rejects the duplicate and cascades later requests from that policy, while retaining valid requests from other policies.

rejection_context: General metadata receives the filter rejection list. Direct metadata receives an empty list. When the retained body selects the direct path, this commit emits no IntentRejected events for those filtered rejections, does not remove those intents from the local mempool if present, and omits their rejection-based proposer-frontier refresh. Other later cleanup is separate. This is source analysis, not a new differential run.
alternative_storage: Copy-on-write, persistent maps, and touched-market overlays are alternative general copy reductions. No comparative result is recorded.
deployed_gain: Per-candidate full-store filter copies and the outer durable engine clone remain before the May prechecked commit. The April gain supplies no measured estimate of deployed speedup.

pub(crate) fn parse_mahi_merged_execution_batch_size() -> usize {
    env::var(MAHI_MERGED_EXECUTION_BATCH_ENV)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|value| value.trim().parse::<usize>().ok())
        .filter(|value| *value > 0)
        .unwrap_or(DEFAULT_MAHI_MERGED_EXECUTION_BATCH_SIZE)
}

structures: PolicyStore: derived Clone over owned BTreeMap
full_store_clones_in_filter.count: m+1 per structure for m candidates that reach simulation
full_store_clones_in_filter.early_exclusions: Burned-policy cascade rejection and nonce mismatch skip candidate simulation.
full_store_clones_in_filter.other_filter_copies: Accumulated simulated order-book and isolated-collateral maps are cloned per simulated candidate.

copy_scope.april_proxy: Nonce-only filter, without the May per-candidate simulation copies.
copy_scope.runtime_cost_ranking: Not measured. Clone counts do not rank their total cost against all four later overlays.

failed_verification.drain_behavior: Both drains stop at the first block not marked Verified. A Failed block blocks its group and all later execution in that queue.
failed_verification.ordering: The commit detector queues decided blocks without checking payload verification status.
failed_verification.failure_handler: Sets Failed; no automatic retry or agreed skip rule.
failed_verification.duplicate_receipt: Can enqueue a new job and overwrite status. Reverification cannot repair a deterministically invalid signature under fixed inputs.
failed_verification.reset: Replaces the queue and starts a local segment, with the separate recovery-boundary gap.
failed_verification.replica_scope: If the common decided block fails deterministically under common verification inputs, each replica halts at this boundary.
failed_verification.evidence: Source analysis; no reproduced outage or new test.
duplicate_receipt_trace: MahiState::accept_block returns Ok(existing) when the same author-round block reference arrives again.
process_decoded_network_mahi_block calls enqueue_mahi_sigverify after acceptance, including an existing reference.
enqueue_mahi_sigverify submits a job for nonempty intents when the pool exists.
apply_mahi_sigverify_result writes Verified or Failed for that reference.
fetch_mahi_missing_block also enqueues accepted fetched blocks. This is not an automatic failed-block retry loop.
